newsitem.title: USA: Atchison Casting buys Canada Alloy.
newsitem.headline: Atchison Casting buys Canada Alloy.

text.p: Atchison Casting Corp said it purchased Canada Alloy Castings Ltd of Kitchener, Ontario, for approximately US$4.3 million in cash.
Canada Alloy's net sales for fiscal 1996 were $11.3 million, it added.
Canada Alloy produces stainless, carbon and alloy steel castings for a variety of markets, including power generation equipment, pulp and paper machinery, pumps and valves.

"The skills and customer base of Canada Alloy will complement those of several other Atchison foundries, including Canadian Steel Foundries in Montreal and Quaker Alloy in Myerstown, Pa.," Don Marlborough, group vice president, said in a statement.
Atchison Casting produces iron, steel and non-ferrous castings for a wide variety of equipment, capital goods and consumer markets.
